items.a: ERYON AI is an enterprise software development agency based in New Delhi, India. We build custom web applications, mobile apps, SaaS platforms, CRM and ERP systems, e-commerce solutions, AI and automation solutions, data analytics platforms, and cloud and DevOps infrastructure, with UI/UX design across all of them.

items.q: Which countries does ERYON AI work with?
items.a: We are based in New Delhi, India and serve clients in India, the USA, the UK, the UAE, Australia, and Canada. Projects are delivered remotely with transparent sprints and weekly demos.

items.q: What technologies does ERYON AI use?
items.a: Our core stack includes React, Next.js, Node.js, Spring Boot, and Python (FastAPI) for applications; PostgreSQL, MongoDB, and Redis for data; AWS, Google Cloud, and Azure with Docker and Kubernetes for infrastructure; React Native and Flutter for mobile; and OpenAI, TensorFlow, and LangChain for AI.

items.q: How does a project with ERYON AI work?
items.a: Every project follows five stages: Discovery & Planning, Design & Architecture, Development & Testing, Deployment & Launch, and Maintenance & Growth. Work is delivered in agile sprints with code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD pipelines.

items.q: How do I get a quote or start a project?
items.a: Send your requirements through the contact form, email connect@eryonai.com, or call +91-78278-86571. You get a free consultation and a tailored proposal within 24 hours.

items.q: Does ERYON AI provide support after launch?
items.a: Yes. After launch we provide ongoing maintenance, monitoring, and optimization, including feature enhancements as your product grows.
